entries.text: Hi, it's Sarah from HeliumDeploy. Thanks for taking a few minutes with me: your code, 10% off, shows up on screen as soon as we finish. I see you were looking at the Bugatti Gatsby Carry-On. What caught your eye?
It's for a two week trip to Portugal with my wife in November. We fly Air Transat.
A two-week Portugal trip with your wife sounds lovely. November should be a nice time to go. Are you packing light for both of you, or is it mostly your bag you're picking out?
Mostly it has to fit the carry on size limit and be light. I really hate heavy bags.
Light and carry-on size, that makes sense, especially for two weeks. The product page has the exact weight and dimensions. What else are you comparing it with, other stores or brands?
